means.idiom-jp: たまたま…だ。；折よく[運悪く]…だ。
means.example-sentence: Yesterday, it happened that an old friend of mine and I were riding in the same train car.
means.sentence-jp: 昨日、たまたま旧友と私は列車の同じ車両に乗っていた。

cloze.maskedText: Yesterday, ____ an old friend of mine and I were riding in the same train car.
